items.title: Watch: Leaked photos reveal extensive damage at US bases in Gulf
items.dek: The photos, provided by active military personnel, show a severed radar jet, flattened trailers and severely damaged buildings as a result of Iranian strikes.

items.title: US interest rates raised for first time in three years
items.dek: The Federal Reserve unanimously voted to increase interest rates to 3.75%-4% from 3.5%-3.75% on Wednesday.
